column1: # Platform exceptions: the Python tests whose ported Rust test may run on one platform only.
# A ledger row may say `platform:<linux|macos>` in its note only when its (python_id, platform)
# pair is listed here (`anthology-dev ledger check`). CONTROLLER-OWNED: lanes never edit this
# file; a lane that needs an exception asks the controller, who adds the row in a plumbing PR
# with the reason (the Python test itself runs on that platform only). Empty: no id qualifies.
